findings.summary: Company wallet balances are gated only by module access
findings.details: `GET /api/v1/wallets/company/{companyId}` requires only `module.redemption_store`, but the service path allows any non-partner-seller/non-partner-admin caller through after only checking that the company belongs to the tenant. In a permission model with configurable roles, an internal user granted module access without all-history/admin authority can read any company wallet in the tenant, despite the endpoint contract saying CLIENT_ADMIN only. This exposes financial balance data across partner companies.
findings.recommendation: Require `action.redemption.view_all_history` or an explicit CLIENT_ADMIN/platform role check for company-wallet reads, while keeping the partner-admin own-company exception separate and tested.

findings.summary: Xoxoday sync can mass-deactivate valid catalog items on partial provider results
findings.details: The sync treats one provider response as the complete source of truth and deactivates every active NON_CASH item whose provider id is absent. The only guard allows responses as small as 20% of the current active catalog, so a paginated, truncated, stale, or partially failed provider response containing just over that threshold can deactivate most redeemable items in one run. This is an irreversible user-visible availability failure until an admin detects and repairs the catalog.
findings.recommendation: Only deactivate after a verified full-catalog sync: implement provider pagination/total validation, stage results before applying, and require consecutive successful full syncs or explicit admin confirmation before deactivating missing provider items.

classificationRules.blockingThreshold: severity critical/high AND confidence >= 0.70 AND not alreadyHandled
classificationRules.advisoryThreshold: severity medium/low OR confidence < 0.70 OR alreadyHandled
